name: Auto Enroll for Tutor LMS
author: Kotak Digital

sections.description:
Auto Enroll is a simple yet powerful plugin that automatically enrolls users into pre-selected courses when they register. Designed specifically for Tutor LMS, it eliminates the need for manual course enrollment and ensures that new users are instantly enrolled into the right courses.

With the option to enable Auto Approve for Paid Courses, you can ensure that all paid courses are automatically approved without the need for admin intervention. This option is perfect for streamlining the enrollment process for paid courses, ensuring a smooth experience for both the admin and users.

The plugin is fully customizable, allowing you to select multiple courses for automatic enrollment and even disable the auto-enroll feature at any time by deactivating the plugin. If you want to make the most of Tutor LMS by automating the enrollment process, this plugin is the perfect solution for you!

Features:

  • Automatically enroll new users into selected courses.
  • Option to enable auto-approval for paid courses.
  • Seamless integration with Tutor LMS.
  • Easy to set up and configure via the admin panel.
  • Customizable settings to select courses for automatic enrollment.
  • Works with both free and paid courses.
  • Disable the auto-enroll feature at any time by deactivating the plugin.

Auto Approve Paid Courses (Optional)
When enabled, paid course enrollments will be automatically approved and the related WooCommerce orders marked as “Completed”. If disabled, enrollments remain pending and orders won’t be completed automatically.

Note: Enabling this means users will get access to paid courses for free upon registration. Make sure this behavior fits your site’s goals before turning it on.

Development Notes

This plugin uses the following third-party libraries:

  • SweetAlert2 (https://github.com/sweetalert2/sweetalert2)
  • Multiselect JS (https://github.com/crlcu/multiselect)

The unminified versions of these libraries are included in the plugin for transparency and developer reference. Only minified versions are enqueued for performance.
sections.faq:
How does this plugin work?

This plugin automatically enrolls new users into selected courses in Tutor LMS as soon as they register. You can select which courses you want users to be enrolled in through the plugin’s settings page. Additionally, you can enable the option to auto-approve paid courses for automatic enrollment.

Can I choose multiple courses for auto-enrollment?

Yes, you can select multiple courses for auto-enrollment. The plugin allows you to choose as many courses as you want, and new users will automatically be enrolled in those courses upon registration.

How can I stop the automatic enrollment?

If you want to stop the automatic enrollment feature, you can simply deactivate the plugin. This will disable the auto-enroll functionality, and users will no longer be automatically enrolled in the selected courses.

Do I need Tutor LMS Pro to use this plugin?

No, this plugin works with both the free and pro versions of Tutor LMS. You can use it seamlessly without needing Tutor LMS Pro.

Is this plugin compatible with both free and paid courses?

Yes, this plugin is compatible with both free and paid courses in Tutor LMS.

Does this plugin support Course Subscriptions and Memberships?

This plugin is designed to handle user enrollment and WooCommerce order statuses, so it should work with subscription-based and membership-based courses in Tutor LMS. While it hasn’t been extensively tested in those scenarios, the logic is expected to be compatible. We recommend testing it with your setup to confirm everything runs smoothly.
